title: The Death of Forward Guidance
description: To hear the financial commentariat tell it, Kevin Warsh’s decision to strip forward guidance from the FOMC statement is nothing short of monetary heresy.

title: Peso touches P61.995:$1
description: THE peso came close to hitting P62 to the dollar on Wednesday, posting a new intraday record low of P61.995 to the greenback before ending the day 3 centavos weaker at P61.815:$1.
